AddOrderItemsBatchRequest.title: AddOrderItemsBatchRequest
AddOrderItemsBatchRequest.description: Add several items (and optionally send) in one round-trip.

BillingRegion.title: BillingRegion
BillingRegion.description:
Región de facturación del SaaS. Binaria: Argentina (precio local PPP) vs
Internacional (precio full). Determina moneda y riel de cobro.

CashMovementKind.title: CashMovementKind
CashMovementKind.description:
A manual cash-drawer movement that is NOT a sale: it moves physical cash
in or out of the drawer and so shifts what the arqueo Z should find at close.

- ``DEPOSIT`` (ingreso/reposición de cambio): cash in  → +
- ``DROP`` (sangría / retiro a caja fuerte):  cash out → −
- ``PAYOUT`` (pago en efectivo desde el cajón): cash out → −

DocType.title: DocType
DocType.description: Documento del receptor (códigos AFIP 80/86/96/99 en el adapter).

FeeRateItem.title: FeeRateItem
FeeRateItem.description: Comisiones (slice B): la tasa de un método, en bps (300 = 3%).

FloorSessionResponse.title: FloorSessionResponse
FloorSessionResponse.description: The session-aware live view of a table (derived state + timer + pax).

IngredientCostPointResponse.title: IngredientCostPointResponse
IngredientCostPointResponse.description: Fase 2D: un punto del histórico de costo de un insumo (una compra).

LeadRequest.title: LeadRequest
LeadRequest.description: Formulario público de la landing. Los largos acotan lo que entra sin auth.

PlanTier.title: PlanTier
PlanTier.description: Nivel del plan de suscripción. Extensible (agregar tiers no rompe nada).

PublicPaymentReceiptResponse.title: PublicPaymentReceiptResponse
PublicPaymentReceiptResponse.description: Recibo NO fiscal del comensal tras pagar (Carta QR F3). No es factura AFIP.

PublicPlanResponse.title: PublicPlanResponse
PublicPlanResponse.description:
Proyección pública del catálogo para la landing (sin auth). Expone solo lo
necesario para mostrar precios; el copy de marketing vive en la landing.

RecipeItemSchema.title: RecipeItemSchema
RecipeItemSchema.description: Un ítem de receta/preparación: un insumo O una preparación, no ambos.

ReservationStatus.title: ReservationStatus
ReservationStatus.description:
Lifecycle of a reservation (reserva).

PENDING → CONFIRMED → SEATED → COMPLETED is the happy path; CANCELLED and
NO_SHOW are terminal off-ramps. The party can be SEATED straight from
PENDING (a walk-in confirmed on arrival).

Station.title: Station
Station.description: Where an item is prepared. Routes items to the right KDS board.

TableBillResponse.title: TableBillResponse
TableBillResponse.description:
La cuenta de la mesa que ve el comensal (Carta QR F3). Todo server-side:
total/pagado/saldo en minor units. ``online_pay_available`` decide si la carta
ofrece pagar online o cae a "pagá con el mozo"; ``tips_enabled`` muestra/oculta
el selector de propina.

TablePayRequest.title: TablePayRequest
TablePayRequest.description:
El comensal inicia el pago (Carta QR F3). El monto lo acota el server (saldo
de la orden). ``amount`` opcional = dividir la cuenta / pagar una parte (0 <
amount ≤ saldo); ausente = pagar todo el saldo. La ``idempotency_key`` evita
que un doble-tap cobre dos veces.

TaxQuoteResponse.title: TaxQuoteResponse
TaxQuoteResponse.description:
Sales tax to add on an order (minor units). For AR/IVA tax is 0 (included);
for US it comes from the tax engine (TaxJar) by the tenant's fiscal address.

TipPayoutResponse.title: TipPayoutResponse
TipPayoutResponse.description: Guarda D: liquidación en el ledger de propinas (no es un egreso).

UnitOfMeasure.title: UnitOfMeasure
UnitOfMeasure.description:
Base unit an ingredient (insumo) is measured in. No automatic conversion
between units (kg↔g deferred): stock, recipe and purchase all share the
ingredient's own base unit.
